entrances.spaceHolds: one zombie standee or one barricade token
entrances.zombiePlacementOrder: entrance number ascending, wrapping after 6; the first zombie goes on entrance 1, the second on entrance 2
entrances.overrun: when the entrance chosen for a new zombie has no empty space and no barricade, the zombie is not placed and the lowest-influence survivor there dies (or a helpless token)

occupants.holds: one survivor standee or one helpless survivor token
occupants.fullRule: when no occupant space is empty, no Crossroads card, item card or ability can add a survivor or a helpless token

locationCards.randomLocation: roll a d6 and take the location with that number; the colony is never random

sources.entrances.spacesPerEntrance: R p5 diagram; PHOTO colony entrances 4-5 (locations-sources.md L4)
